structure.hook: Open with a visible product state, result, or motion system rather than a generic title.
structure.progression: Move through use-case-specific scenes whose information and motion are controlled by structured props.
structure.proof: Let real product states, data, or readable interface changes carry the proof.
structure.payoff: Resolve the visual system into one brand proposition and clear action.

transferRules.instruction: Select a Remotion composition pattern by video use case and proof object before choosing visual effects.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Showcase introduction: products, campaigns, launch videos, tutorials and creative tools

transferRules.instruction: Review motion at scene and boundary level; do not judge a template from a static thumbnail.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Showcase introduction: open any card to watch the motion in detail

structure.hook: Begin inside an unusual but controlled situation whose meaning is initially incomplete.
structure.progression: Reveal the physical relationship slowly while preserving one unbroken proof event.
structure.proof: The central action visibly demonstrates the product capability instead of describing it.
structure.payoff: Let the completed proof event become the brand claim.

transferRules.instruction: Convert the primary product claim into one visually undeniable event and remove shots that do not deepen that proof.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Official film: central continuous product-proof event

entries.title: Google — Parisian Love

structure.hook: Introduce a human intention through a simple product action.
structure.progression: Each new product state changes the implied human story.
structure.proof: The interface is not decoration; every operation causes a narrative consequence.
structure.payoff: Accumulated small actions resolve into an emotional life change.

transferRules.instruction: For screen demos, require each UI action to change the audience's understanding, task state, or emotional stakes.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Official film: sequential product operations carry the complete narrative

antiPatterns: screen recording without narrative state change

entries.title: Metro Trains Melbourne — Dumb Ways to Die

structure.hook: Establish a simple repeatable audiovisual phrase.
structure.progression: Repeat the same grammar with escalating visual variation.
structure.proof: Memorability is built through pattern recognition before the serious context appears.
structure.payoff: Reframe the repeated phrase as a concrete safety message.

transferRules.instruction: Use repetition only when each variation advances recognition or escalation, then reframe the pattern into the final message.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Official campaign film: repeated audiovisual syntax resolves into the safety purpose

antiPatterns: late message with no structural setup

entries.title: Dollar Shave Club — Our Blades Are Great

structure.hook: State the proposition immediately through a distinctive spokesperson voice.
structure.progression: Move through objections and product benefits while every visual beat supports the spoken claim.
structure.proof: Comedy and blocking carry product information rather than interrupting it.
structure.payoff: End on a direct commercial action.

transferRules.instruction: In a humorous product film, every comic beat must also prove a benefit, answer an objection, or strengthen the CTA.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Official launch film: visual comedy and spoken product argument progress together

entries.title: Apple — Behind the scenes at Scary Fast

structure.hook: Use a controlled nocturnal visual world to establish the event's production promise.
structure.progression: Combine presenters, product contexts, locations, and complex camera movement through a synchronized production workflow.
structure.proof: The behind-the-scenes evidence names rigs, timecode, monitoring, Log capture, and color grading.
structure.payoff: Production process becomes credible evidence for the product claim.

transferRules.instruction: Treat cinematic quality as coordinated camera, lighting, sync, monitoring, and grading decisions; do not reduce it to LUTs or shallow depth of field.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Apple Newsroom paragraphs 50-75: synchronized devices, rigs, low-light capture, dollies, cranes, drones and post-production

entries.title: Apple MAMI Select — Seeing Red production study

structure.hook: Introduce a repeated emotional action whose meaning can later change.
structure.progression: Use lens choice, slow motion, and foreground-background staging to connect family power and character emotion.
structure.proof: The official production study ties specific focal lengths and frame arrangement to narrative meaning.
structure.payoff: Repeat the opening action with a transformed emotional meaning.

transferRules.instruction: Choose focal length and foreground-background placement to express character power or emotional distance, not merely for visual variety.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Apple Newsroom production study: 120 mm composition and 4K120 slow-motion scream motif

entries.title: Burger King — Moldy Whopper

structure.hook: Break the category's beauty convention with an initially undesirable product state.
structure.progression: Hold product identity and chronology stable while the visible condition changes.
structure.proof: Use time, repeated framing, and an observable physical result as a bounded proof event.
structure.payoff: Reframe the undesirable visual outcome as evidence for the approved proposition.

transferRules.instruction: Look for a category convention the product can truthfully violate, then preserve the conditions and limitations that make the visible state meaningful.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Award case and film chronology

antiPatterns: treating a visual metaphor as complete scientific evidence
shock detached from the product claim

structure.hook: Establish a constrained human state before the product experience begins.
structure.progression: Let music progressively change body, room, scale, and emotional freedom.
structure.proof: The film visualizes a subjective experience rather than claiming a measured technical result.
structure.payoff: Resolve the expanded physical world into a clear product and brand memory.

transferRules.instruction: Translate an approved invisible experience into observable changes in environment, body, light, or scale, while labeling it as experiential rather than objective proof.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Award case description and finished film progression

entries.title: The New York Times — The Truth Is Worth It: Rigor

structure.hook: Enter the work while the search for truth is already under pressure.
structure.progression: Accumulate calls, records, interviews, obstacles, and verification effort.
structure.proof: Make rigor visible through repeated actions, cost, and traceable evidence.
structure.payoff: Let the completed work justify the brand value statement.

transferRules.instruction: For an abstract brand value, show the decisions, labor, risk, and result that make the value observable instead of stating it as a slogan.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Award case and process-led film structure

entries.title: Tide — It's a Tide Ad

structure.hook: Withhold the category identity and invite the viewer to classify the advertisement.
structure.progression: Move through different category surfaces while preserving one visual product truth.
structure.proof: Repeatedly use the same product benefit to reinterpret each new context.
structure.payoff: Turn brand repetition into the rule of a viewer participation game.

transferRules.instruction: Find one approved product truth capable of reinterpreting multiple situations, then vary the context while preserving the same observable proof.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Campaign case and repeated category reveal

antiPatterns: genre switching that obscures the claim

entries.title: Channel 4 — Meet the Superhumans

structure.hook: Establish strength and intensity before explanatory context.
structure.progression: Escalate from training and body mechanics to cost, history, and competition.
structure.proof: Use observable effort, impact, equipment, and reaction to establish athletic stakes.
structure.payoff: Convert changed audience attitude into anticipation for the event.

transferRules.instruction: Decide the attitude the audience should adopt toward the subject, then choose the opening proof images before adding biography or explanation.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Award case and finished-film progression

antiPatterns: intensity montage without changing audience understanding

entries.title: Google — Year in Search 2020

structure.hook: Begin with a recurring human question rather than a corporate answer.
structure.progression: Use changing search language to organize heterogeneous public events and emotions.
structure.proof: Let queries, archive media, voices, and social actions jointly evidence the collective state.
structure.payoff: Allow the same word to evolve from uncertainty toward agency and hope.

transferRules.instruction: Choose one approved word or question that can change meaning across the film, then use it to order heterogeneous assets into a causal emotional arc.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Official campaign page and film's recurring query structure

antiPatterns: emotion montage without a semantic spine

entries.title: GitHub Unwrapped

structure.hook: Open with a personally recognizable identity or result.
structure.progression: Turn structured activity data into a sequence of increasingly meaningful chapters.
structure.proof: Use the viewer's real data as the evidence rather than generic celebratory graphics.
structure.payoff: Resolve the accumulated story into a concise, shareable personal summary.

transferRules.instruction: Map each accepted data field to one scene purpose and one visible conclusion; omit fields that do not change the viewer's understanding.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Repository purpose and structured year-in-review implementation

transferRules.instruction: Keep scene contracts, typography and motion grammar stable while data and selected chapter count vary through validated props.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Reusable Remotion composition and personalized output structure

antiPatterns: one chart style repeated without escalation

structure.hook: Begin with a concrete media problem or surprising result.
structure.progression: Reveal the system through increasingly capable media operations and states.
structure.proof: Use readable media behavior and structured visual states to demonstrate the capability.
structure.payoff: Connect the proof to a clear release or usage action.

transferRules.instruction: For developer products, show valid inputs, state transitions and outputs at readable scale; reserve abstract motion for orientation and emphasis.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Announcement repository and product-led film structure

structure.hook: State the scale or consequence of the update before enumerating features.
structure.progression: Group related features into chapters with distinct proof objects.
structure.proof: Show what changed in behavior or output rather than only naming the feature.
structure.payoff: Resolve the chapters into an upgrade, try-now, or documentation action.

transferRules.instruction: Give every feature chapter one user consequence and one observable before-after state; delete chapters that only repeat release notes.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Announcement repository and feature-led sequence

entries.title: Ship a Contribution Graph Video Generator with Remotion and Vercel

structure.hook: Open with the generated result and its personalization value.
structure.progression: Move from data input to visual mapping, composition and hosted rendering.
structure.proof: Demonstrate that the same typed pipeline produces a valid personalized output.
structure.payoff: End with a usable generator rather than an isolated animation.

transferRules.instruction: For a video-generator product, show input validation, deterministic composition, rendering and output delivery as one traceable path.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Repository architecture and Vercel rendering purpose

antiPatterns: beautiful local preview without deployable render

structure.hook: Make the spoken hook readable from the first frame of speech.
structure.progression: Paginate the transcript into readable thought units while preserving word timing.
structure.proof: Highlight the currently spoken word without obscuring the subject or changing the transcript meaning.
structure.payoff: Carry the final claim and CTA in a readable, platform-safe caption state.

transferRules.instruction: Validate transcript, word timestamps and page boundaries before choosing caption animation; styling cannot repair missing or rushed narration.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Template purpose, Whisper.cpp integration and animated word-level caption workflow

structure.hook: Resolve a story premise into a compact opening beat before asset generation.
structure.progression: Generate and bind story details, images, text and voice to explicit timeline blocks.
structure.proof: Keep generated assets synchronized through a machine-readable timeline instead of manual placement.
structure.payoff: Render a reproducible social video that can be regenerated from structured inputs.

transferRules.instruction: Persist script, asset prompts, selected files, voice timings and timeline blocks separately so a failed shot can be regenerated without rebuilding the entire video.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Template README: generated story, images, voiceover and timeline blocks

entries.title: Nike — You Can't Stop Us

structure.hook: Create one fixed visual rule that the audience understands immediately.
structure.progression: Escalate subjects and contexts while preserving the rule.
structure.proof: Every matched action visibly demonstrates connection across difference.
structure.payoff: Resolve accumulated matches into one collective proposition.

transferRules.instruction: When cut density is high, keep layout, subject position, motion vector, color or sound grammar stable so each new shot adds information without resetting comprehension.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Official agency case and paired-action structure

antiPatterns: rapid cuts without a stable visual rule

structure.hook: Open on a familiar flawed result.
structure.progression: Repeat problem, operation, matched result and reaction as compact proof units.
structure.proof: Hold composition stable enough to compare the exact change.
structure.payoff: Accumulate proof units into a memorable product proposition.

transferRules.instruction: For software or image changes, keep proof shots stable and comparable; do not combine a moving camera, dense text and a second claim in the same proof interval.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Official campaign page and before-after feature presentation

structure.hook: Begin with one precise physical action whose consequence is not yet known.
structure.progression: Make each mechanism trigger the next in visible causal order.
structure.proof: Let real component behavior carry product meaning.
structure.payoff: Reveal the complete product as the consequence of the chain.

transferRules.instruction: When product mechanics are the proof, preserve action phase, prop state, direction and edit handles so every insert motivates the next shot.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Official campaign page and causal mechanism structure

entries.title: Apple — Introducing Apple Vision Pro

structure.hook: Establish a new product category and its human context.
structure.progression: Move from environment and use to discrete capability chapters.
structure.proof: Pair each capability with readable human action or interface state.
structure.payoff: Resolve the experience into a controlled product hero and category claim.

transferRules.instruction: For a new technology, cover environment, human use, mechanism proof, consequence and product hero in that order unless the Director records a deliberate reveal inversion.
transferRules.evidenceLocator: Official launch page and product capability structure

antiPatterns: product beauty shots without capability proof
